decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development would, by reason of its size, scale, position and appearance, fail to meet the Council's housing standards constituting over-development of the site. The proposal would be detrimental to the amenities of the adjoining neighbours, visual amenities of the street scene and character of the local area. The proposal is contrary to policies ENV.1.1, H.1.2 and H.3.3 of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan and policies ENV-B.1.1, H.4.1 and H.6.3 of the Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan and associated Supplementary Planning Guidance.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development provides inappropriate off-street parking that would result in conditions that would prejudice the safe movement of motorists and pedestrians in the area.  The proposal is contrary to policies ENV.1.1, T.2.5 and T.2.7a of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan, and policies ENV-B.1.1, T.1.4 and T.5.3 of the Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan.
description: Erection of a two-storey 4 X bedroomed semi detached dwellinghouse with associated parking and landscaping.
